subject_context: Every US Submarine Class Ever Built

facts.claim: Holland’s commander advocated her use as a war vessel for coast and harbor defense.
facts.scope: Contemporary operational promise, not proof of the original procurement requirement or combat success.

facts.claim: Holland combined dual propulsion, separate main and auxiliary ballast systems, and a hydrodynamic hull shape.
facts.scope: Documented design features of USS Holland.

facts.claim: Holland served at the U.S. Naval Academy as a training submarine.
Improved Holland-type submarines became the Navy’s A-class.
facts.scope: Design successors; omit disputed boat count.
